q.hi: Parking lot me weekend pricing aur "upar wale floor pehle bharo" rule bina `ParkingLot` badle add karne hain. Kaunsa pattern?
q.en: You must add weekend pricing and a "fill upper floors first" rule without touching `ParkingLot`. Which pattern?

hi: Singleton
Observer
Strategy (`PricingStrategy`, `SpotAllocationStrategy`)
Factory (`VehicleFactory`)
en: Singleton
Observer
Strategy (`PricingStrategy`, `SpotAllocationStrategy`)
Factory (`VehicleFactory`)

why.hi: Pluggable rules = Strategy. `if (type == ...)` chain me har naye rule pe purana code khulta.
why.en: Pluggable rules = Strategy. An `if (type == ...)` chain reopens old code for every new rule.

q.hi: Gate A aur Gate B dono ne ek hi spot free dekha aur dono ne assign kar diya. Site ka recommended fix?
q.en: Gate A and Gate B both saw the same spot free and both assigned it. The site recommended fix?

hi: `tryOccupy` = `compareAndSet(null, vehicle)`; haarne wala gate agla spot try kare
Assign se pehle `isFree()` do baar check karo
DisplayBoard ko har second poll karwao
Spot object ko `volatile` bana do
en: `tryOccupy` = `compareAndSet(null, vehicle)`; the losing gate tries the next spot
Call `isFree()` twice before assigning
Have the DisplayBoard poll every second
Make the spot object `volatile`

why.hi: Check aur occupy ek atomic step hona chahiye. `isFree()` sirf sasta filter hai, correctness CAS deta hai. Simple alternative: global `synchronized park()` (gates serialize).
why.en: Check and occupy must be one atomic step. `isFree()` is only a cheap filter; CAS gives correctness. Simple alternative: a global `synchronized park()` (gates serialize).

q.hi: Exit pe payment fail ho gaya. Sahi behaviour kya hai?
q.en: Payment fails at exit. What is the correct behaviour?

hi: Spot free karo aur ticket delete karo, payment baad me lo
Ticket ko used mark karo taaki dusra gate use na kare
Barrier khol do aur plate ko blacklist karo
Ticket wapas `active` me, spot free nahi hota, barrier band rehta hai
en: Free the spot and delete the ticket; collect payment later
Mark the ticket used so no other gate can use it
Open the barrier and blacklist the plate
The ticket goes back to `active`, the spot is not freed, the barrier stays closed

why.hi: Exit ek claim hai (`active.remove`); payment fail ho to claim undo karo taaki gaadi andar hi rahe aur state consistent rahe.
why.en: Exit is a claim (`active.remove`); if payment fails, undo the claim so the car stays inside and state stays consistent.

q.hi: Elevator car ka behaviour Idle, MovingUp, MovingDown, Maintenance me alag hai. Ise model karne ke liye kaunsa pattern?
q.en: An elevator car behaves differently in Idle, MovingUp, MovingDown and Maintenance. Which pattern models this?

hi: Strategy
State
Command
Observer
en: Strategy
State
Command
Observer

why.hi: Car khud state badalti hai (moving up → idle), har state ek class. Strategy (dispatch algo) bahar se set hoti hai.
why.en: The car changes its own state (moving up → idle), one class per state. Strategy (dispatch algo) is set from outside.

q.hi: Design me `Elevator` class pe koi lock nahi hai, phir bhi race nahi hoti. Kyun?
q.en: The design has no lock on `Elevator`, yet there is no race. Why?

hi: Har car ka apna thread hai jo `synchronized` hai
Buttons sirf `LinkedBlockingQueue` me `submit()` karte hain; ek controller thread `tick()` chala ke car state ka akela writer hai
Fields `final` hain, isliye kabhi badalte nahi
Java me int writes atomic hote hain, lock ki zarurat nahi
en: Each car has its own `synchronized` thread
Buttons only `submit()` into a `LinkedBlockingQueue`; one controller thread runs `tick()` and is the only writer of car state
The fields are `final`, so they never change
Int writes are atomic in Java, so no lock is needed

why.hi: Ye actor/event-loop model hai, Command objects queue me jaate hain. `volatile` sirf dashboard reads ke liye.
why.en: This is an actor/event-loop model with Command objects in a queue. `volatile` is only for dashboard reads.

q.hi: SSTF (hamesha sabse paas wala stop) ki jagah LOOK kyun chuna gaya?
q.en: Why was LOOK chosen over SSTF (always the nearest stop)?

hi: LOOK hamesha top floor tak jaata hai, isliye fair hai
SSTF ko sorted set nahi chahiye, LOOK ko chahiye
LOOK total travel distance hamesha minimum karta hai
SSTF me door ke floors starve ho sakte hain; LOOK ek direction ke saare stops khatam karke palatta hai, wait max ~2 sweeps
en: LOOK always goes to the top floor, so it is fair
SSTF needs no sorted set, LOOK does
LOOK always minimises total travel distance
SSTF can starve far floors; LOOK finishes all stops in one direction before reversing, so the wait is at most ~2 sweeps

why.hi: Last floor tak jaana SCAN hai (bekaar travel); LOOK aakhri request pe palat jaata hai. Aur strong guarantee ke liye aging.
why.en: Going to the last floor is SCAN (wasted travel); LOOK reverses at the last request. Add aging for a stronger guarantee.

q.hi: Vending machine me product price kis type me rakhna chahiye?
q.en: What type should a vending machine use for product price?

hi: `int` rupees / `long` paise
`double`
`float`
`String`, display ke liye
en: `int` rupees / `long` paise
`double`
`float`
`String`, for display

why.hi: `double` me 0.1 + 0.2 jaisi rounding galti hoti hai. Paise integer me rakho.
why.en: `double` has rounding errors like 0.1 + 0.2. Keep money as integers.

q.hi: Customer ke daale coins seedha cash box me na daal ke "escrow" me kyun rakhte hain?
q.en: Why are inserted coins kept in "escrow" instead of going straight into the cash box?

hi: Taaki Singleton thread-safe ho
Taaki UPI webhook fast aaye
Cancel pe wahi coins wapas, change banane ka risk hi nahi
Cash box me jagah bachane ke liye
en: So the Singleton becomes thread-safe
So the UPI webhook arrives faster
On cancel the same coins go back, so there is no risk of failing to make change
To save space in the cash box

why.hi: Sale pakki hone tak coins escrow me. Seedha box me daalte to cancel pe change dena padta, jo fail ho sakta hai.
why.en: Coins stay in escrow until the sale is final. Putting them in the box would require change on cancel, which can fail.

q.hi: ₹6 change dena hai, cash box me {5, 2, 2, 2} hain. Greedy change ke saath kya hota hai aur fix?
q.en: You must return ₹6 change and the box has {5, 2, 2, 2}. What happens with greedy change and what is the fix?

hi: Greedy hamesha optimal hai Indian coins pe, koi problem nahi
Sale ke baad change check karo, fail ho to admin alert
5 + 2 = 7 de do, ₹1 extra chalega
Greedy 5 leke atak jaata hai (1 nahi); limited counts pe bounded coin-change DP use karo
en: Greedy is always optimal for Indian coins, no problem
Check change after the sale and alert the admin on failure
Give 5 + 2 = 7; ₹1 extra is fine
Greedy takes 5 and gets stuck (no 1); use a bounded coin-change DP for limited counts

why.hi: Greedy unlimited coins pe optimal hai, limited counts pe nahi. Aur `canSettle` dispense se pehle chalta hai (order: change check → dispense → settle).
why.en: Greedy is optimal with unlimited coins, not limited counts. `canSettle` runs before dispense (order: change check → dispense → settle).

q.hi: ₹100 ko 3 logon me EQUAL split karna hai (paise me). Sahi shares?
q.en: Split ₹100 EQUAL among 3 people (in paise). Correct shares?

hi: 33.33 har ek, `double` me
3333 har ek, 1 paisa chhod do
3334, 3333, 3333 (leftover paisa deterministic order me)
3334 kisi random user ko, baaki 3333
en: 33.33 each, as `double`
3333 each and drop 1 paisa
3334, 3333, 3333 (leftover paisa in a deterministic order)
3334 to a random user, the rest 3333

why.hi: Random nahi, participants list ke order me, warna do servers alag balance banayenge. Sum exactly total hona chahiye.
why.en: Not random; follow the participants order, or two servers compute different balances. The sum must equal the total exactly.

q.hi: Naya split type (shares/ratio) add karna hai bina `ExpenseService` badle. Design kya hai?
q.en: You must add a new split type (shares/ratio) without changing `ExpenseService`. What is the design?

hi: `ExpenseService` me naya `case` add karo
Nayi `SplitStrategy` class + `SplitStrategyFactory` me map entry
`Expense` record me naya mutable field
`ExpenseListener` me split logic daalo
en: Add a new `case` in `ExpenseService`
A new `SplitStrategy` class + an entry in `SplitStrategyFactory`
A new mutable field on the `Expense` record
Put the split logic in `ExpenseListener`

why.hi: Strategy + Factory: caller sirf enum jaanta hai, service open/closed rehti hai. Service phir bhi final check karti hai ki shares ka sum = amount.
why.en: Strategy + Factory: the caller only knows the enum and the service stays open/closed. The service still checks that shares sum to the amount.

q.hi: DB me ek expense kai users ke balance rows update karta hai. Do parallel expenses deadlock na karein, iske liye?
q.en: In the DB one expense updates many users balance rows. How do you stop two parallel expenses from deadlocking?

hi: Rows sorted userId order me `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` se lock karo (ya optimistic `version` + retry)
Notifications transaction ke andar bhejo
Har balance row alag transaction me update karo
`double` ki jagah `BigDecimal` use karo
en: Lock rows in sorted userId order with `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` (or optimistic `version` + retry)
Send notifications inside the transaction
Update each balance row in its own transaction
Use `BigDecimal` instead of `double`

why.hi: Fixed order me locking circular wait todti hai. Alag transactions atomicity tod dete; notifications lock ke bahar hone chahiye.
why.en: Locking in a fixed order breaks circular wait. Separate transactions would break atomicity; notifications belong outside the lock.

q.hi: Booked/locked seat status kahan track hota hai: `Seat` pe ya `Show` pe?
q.en: Where is booked/locked seat status tracked: on `Seat` or on `Show`?

hi: `Seat` pe, kyunki seat physical hai
`Screen` pe
`Show` pe, kyunki same seat har show me alag status rakhti hai
`Theatre` pe
en: On `Seat`, because the seat is physical
On `Screen`
On `Show`, because the same seat has a different status in each show
On `Theatre`

why.hi: Seat screen ki hai (layout fixed), booking show ki. Seat pe status rakhoge to 3 PM ki booking 9 PM ko block kar degi.
why.en: A seat belongs to the screen (fixed layout); booking belongs to the show. Status on Seat would make the 3 PM booking block 9 PM.

q.hi: Seat lock global lock ki jagah per-show lock kyun hai, aur seat-level lock kyun nahi?
q.en: Why is seat locking per show instead of global, and why not per seat?

hi: Per-show: ek movie ka rush doosri ko block nahi karta; seat-level me multi-seat booking pe deadlock risk (sort na karo to)
Global lock fast hai par memory zyada leta hai
Seat-level lock Java me possible nahi
Per-show lock se payment idempotent ho jaata hai
en: Per show: one movie rush does not block another; per-seat risks deadlock on multi-seat bookings (unless sorted)
A global lock is faster but uses more memory
Per-seat locks are not possible in Java
A per-show lock makes payment idempotent

why.hi: user1: A1→A2, user2: A2→A1 = deadlock. Per-show lock simple hai aur ek show ka contention chhota hai.
why.en: user1: A1→A2, user2: A2→A1 = deadlock. A per-show lock is simple and one show contention is small.

q.hi: User payment page pe hai aur uska seat lock (TTL) expire hone wala hai. `confirm()` kya karta hai?
q.en: The user is on the payment page and their seat lock (TTL) is about to expire. What does `confirm()` do?

hi: Seedha charge karo, lock ki chinta commit pe
Cleanup job pe depend karo jo har 30 sec expired locks hataata hai
Lock ko permanent bana do jab tak payment complete na ho
Pay se pehle `lock()` dobara: abhi bhi mera/free hai to TTL extend, warna EXPIRED bina charge; pay ke dauraan expire ho to `commit()` fail → refund
en: Charge directly and worry about the lock at commit
Rely on the cleanup job that purges expired locks every 30 seconds
Make the lock permanent until payment completes
Calls `lock()` again before paying: still mine/free extends the TTL, else EXPIRED without charging; if it expires during pay, `commit()` fails → refund

why.hi: Expiry lazy `isActive` check se hoti hai, cleanup sirf memory ke liye. Correctness confirm ke re-lock aur commit check se aati hai.
why.en: Expiry is a lazy `isActive` check; cleanup is only for memory. Correctness comes from re-locking in confirm and the commit check.

q.hi: O(1) `get` aur `put` ke liye LRU cache ki core structure kya hai?
q.en: What is the core structure of an LRU cache for O(1) `get` and `put`?

hi: TreeMap timestamp ke basis pe
HashMap<K, Node> + doubly linked list (sentinel head/tail)
PriorityQueue access count pe
Sirf ArrayList, end pe add
en: A TreeMap keyed by timestamp
HashMap<K, Node> + doubly linked list (sentinel head/tail)
A PriorityQueue on access count
Only an ArrayList, adding at the end

why.hi: Map se node O(1), list se move/evict O(1). TreeMap/PriorityQueue O(log n) dete hain.
why.en: The map gives O(1) node lookup, the list gives O(1) move/evict. TreeMap/PriorityQueue are O(log n).

q.hi: Node me value ke saath key bhi kyun store karte hain?
q.en: Why does each Node store the key as well as the value?

hi: Hash collision resolve karne ke liye
Evict pe tail node se key leke map se bhi hatana padta hai
Linked list sort karne ke liye
TTL calculate karne ke liye
en: To resolve hash collisions
On eviction you need the tail node key to remove it from the map too
To sort the linked list
To calculate TTL

why.hi: Bina key ke tail node ko list se nikaal doge par map me entry bachi rahegi: `map.remove(lru.key)`.
why.en: Without the key you would unlink the tail but leave the map entry behind: `map.remove(lru.key)`.

q.hi: LRU cache ko thread-safe banane ke liye `ReadWriteLock` (get pe read lock) kyun galat hai?
q.en: Why is a `ReadWriteLock` (read lock on get) wrong for making an LRU cache thread-safe?

hi: ReadWriteLock Java me reentrant nahi hai
Read lock se writes starve hote hain, bas itna
`ConcurrentHashMap` akela kaafi hai, lock ki zarurat nahi
LRU me `get` bhi write hai (node front pe move); do readers saath me list corrupt kar denge
en: ReadWriteLock is not reentrant in Java
Read locks only starve writers, nothing more
A `ConcurrentHashMap` alone is enough, no lock needed
In LRU `get` is also a write (it moves the node to front); two readers together corrupt the list

why.hi: Ek lock map + list dono ko guard kare (`ConcurrentLRUCache` wrapper). ConcurrentHashMap akela combined update atomic nahi karta. Throughput ke liye segments ya Caffeine.
why.en: One lock must guard both map and list (`ConcurrentLRUCache` wrapper). ConcurrentHashMap alone does not make the combined update atomic. For throughput use segments or Caffeine.

q.hi: Game loop ko deterministic test karne ke liye design me kya kiya gaya hai?
q.en: What does the design do so the game loop can be tested deterministically?

hi: `Dice` interface inject hota hai (Strategy + DI); test me `FixedDice`
`Game` ke andar `new Random(42)`
`Board` ko Singleton banaya
Output ko `System.out` se compare karte hain
en: A `Dice` interface is injected (Strategy + DI); tests use `FixedDice`
`new Random(42)` inside `Game`
The `Board` is a Singleton
Tests compare `System.out` output

why.hi: `Game` ke andar Random hardcode karoge to test flaky. Dice inject karo.
why.en: Hardcoding Random inside `Game` makes tests flaky. Inject the dice.

q.hi: `Board` ko Builder se kyun banaya gaya hai?
q.en: Why is `Board` built with a Builder?

hi: Taaki ek hi Board instance poore app me ho
Taaki Board runtime pe badal sake
Snakes/ladders ek-ek add karo, `build()` pe ek jagah validate karo, phir immutable Board
Taaki listeners ko events mil sakein
en: So there is only one Board instance in the app
So the Board can change at runtime
Add snakes/ladders one by one, validate in one place at `build()`, then get an immutable Board
So listeners can receive events

why.hi: Immutable Board kai games safely share kar sakte hain. Bade constructor me validation bikhar jaata.
why.en: An immutable Board can be shared safely by many games. A big constructor scatters validation.

q.hi: Builder kaunsa config reject karta hai?
q.en: Which config does the Builder reject?

hi: Do ladders jinke bottom alag cells pe hain
Snake jiska tail cell 2 pe hai
Board size 100
Ladder ka top kisi snake ka head ho (jump chain), ya last cell pe snake
en: Two ladders with bottoms on different cells
A snake whose tail is on cell 2
A board of size 100
A ladder top that is a snake head (jump chain), or a snake on the last cell

why.hi: Chain se infinite loop/confusion hota hai (aur snake → ladder cycle bhi block). Last cell pe snake = koi jeet hi nahi sakta.
why.en: Chains cause loops/confusion (and blocking them also blocks snake → ladder cycles). A snake on the last cell means nobody can win.

q.hi: ATM me 2000 → 500 → 200 → 100 notes ka breakup kis pattern se?
q.en: Which pattern produces the 2000 → 500 → 200 → 100 note breakup in the ATM?

hi: State
Observer
Chain of Responsibility (`NoteHandler`)
Singleton
en: State
Observer
Chain of Responsibility (`NoteHandler`)
Singleton

why.hi: Har handler apne notes deta hai aur baaki aage bhejta hai. Naya note (50) = naya link.
why.en: Each handler dispenses its notes and passes the rest on. A new note (50) = a new link.

q.hi: Daily withdrawal limit kahan check honi chahiye?
q.en: Where should the daily withdrawal limit be checked?

hi: ATM pe, `AuthenticatedState` me
Bank side pe, balance debit wale same atomic conditional UPDATE me
`CashDispenser` me
Card chip pe
en: At the ATM, in `AuthenticatedState`
On the bank side, in the same atomic conditional UPDATE as the debit
In `CashDispenser`
On the card chip

why.hi: ATM pe check karoge to do ATMs (ya ATM + UPI) se limit bypass ho jayegi. `WHERE balance >= :amt AND withdrawn_today + :amt <= :limit`.
why.en: Checking at the ATM lets two ATMs (or ATM + UPI) bypass the limit. `WHERE balance >= :amt AND withdrawn_today + :amt <= :limit`.

q.hi: Withdrawal me bank debit call timeout ho gaya (status unknown). ATM ko kya karna chahiye?
q.en: During a withdrawal the bank debit call times out (status unknown). What should the ATM do?

hi: Cash mat do; `REVERSAL_PENDING` log karo aur same txnId se idempotent `reverse()` retry karo
Cash de do, debit shayad ho gaya hoga
Naye txnId se debit dobara karo
Card retain karo aur session khatam
en: Do not dispense; log `REVERSAL_PENDING` and retry an idempotent `reverse()` with the same txnId
Dispense cash; the debit probably went through
Retry the debit with a new txnId
Retain the card and end the session

why.hi: Unknown status pe cash dena ghaata ho sakta hai. Same txnId se reverse idempotent hai: debit hua hi nahi to no-op. Naya txnId double debit ka risk.
why.en: Dispensing on unknown status can lose money. Reversing with the same txnId is idempotent: no-op if no debit happened. A new txnId risks a double debit.
